jobs.title: Regional Program Specialist
jobs.description:
YMCA OF METROPOLITAN LOS ANGELES

The LA Y is the Center for Community Well-Being in Los Angeles, committed to building stronger communities by providing equitable programs and services to empower all. We are focused on fighting food insecurity, providing equity in education, making sure every child has the opportunity to experience the joy of sports, ensuring kids and teens have a safe place to grow, learn and live a healthy lifestyle. The LA Y’s health and wellness initiatives offer medical and mental health resources to ensure everyone has access to basic health needs. Our mission is to provide services and resources that contribute to the well-being of our community. The LA Y operates 29 Centers and over 200 program sites across LA County.

\*This position is grant funded, and continued employment is contingent upon the availability and renewal of funding and compliance with grant requirements. Positions may be modified or eliminated if funding is reduced, discontinued, or not renewed.\*

POSITION SUMMARY

* Connect community members impacted by HR1 policy changes and new community engagement requirements to YMCA volunteer opportunities where they can complete required hours and support continued benefit eligibility.
* Match individuals with appropriate YMCA volunteer opportunities based on required hours, location, availability, interests, and ability to participate.
* Guide community members through the volunteer placement process, including identifying opportunities, completing onboarding, and preparing to begin service.
* Work closely with Certified Enrollment Specialists (CES) to receive referrals and connect individuals who need volunteer hours to meet HR1 requirements with available YMCA placements.
* Maintain an up-to-date pipeline of YMCA volunteer opportunities that can support HR1 community engagement requirements, including schedules, capacity, locations, and available hours.
* Partner with YMCA centers to identify and develop volunteer opportunities and support registration, screening, background clearance, orientation, and onboarding.
* Maintain communication with centers regarding volunteer capacity, placements, scheduling, and barriers that may prevent individuals from completing required hours.
* Conduct proactive outreach through community events, resource fairs, schools, partner organizations, YMCA centers, and other trusted community spaces to reach populations impacted by HR1.
* Educate community members on HR1 policy changes, community engagement requirements, potential impacts, required actions, and available YMCA support.
* Stay informed of HR1 policy and implementation updates and share accurate, current information with YMCA centers, partners, and community members.
* Connect individuals to CES enrollment and renewal assistance and additional YMCA programs and resources as needed.
* Build relationships with community organizations and regional partners to strengthen HR1 outreach, referrals, and awareness of YMCA volunteer opportunities.
* Track volunteer referrals, placements, service hours, outreach activities, and other program data to support reporting and follow-up.
* Identify barriers, emerging community needs, and gaps in volunteer capacity and work with centers and program leadership to develop solutions.
* Funding Contingent Position: Continued employment is contingent upon the availability of program funding, ongoing program needs, and satisfactory job performance. Funding beyond the current funding period is not guaranteed.

YMCA LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

The Y’s Leadership Competency Model is comprised of multiple leadership competencies (leadership knowledge, skills, and behaviors required for success in the Y), organized by the four disciplines of cause driven leadership:

* Advancing Our Mission & Cause: Provide visionary leadership to the organization and ensure that all resources are mobilized to adapt to new challenges and needs in the community.
  + Competencies Include: Change Leadership, Engaging Community, Philanthropy, & Volunteerism
* Building Relationships: Connect people to the Y’s cause by developing inclusive relationships, partnerships and collaborations so that Ys can co-create solutions to pressing social needs.
  + Competencies Include: Collaboration, Communication & Influence, Inclusion
* Leading Operations: ensure relevance, effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization so that we can continue to fulfill our promise to the community.
  + Competencies Include: Critical Thinking & Decision Making, Fiscal Management, Functional Expertise, Innovation, Program/Project Management
* Developing & Inspiring Others: support the holistic development of self and others so that everyone can embrace the Y’s cause, sustain the Y’s culture, and inspire others to take individual and collective action to further our impact.
  + Competencies Include: Developing Self & Others, Emotional Maturity

While all competencies are significant the following are critical to success in this position:

* Engaging Community: Builds relationships with YMCA centers, community members, and trusted community partners to expand outreach, connect individuals impacted by HR1 policy changes to volunteer opportunities, and increase access to YMCA resources and support.
* Volunteerism: Connects community members impacted by HR1 community engagement requirements to meaningful YMCA volunteer opportunities and supports them through the placement and onboarding process.
* Collaboration: Works closely with YMCA center staff, Certified Enrollment Specialists, community partners, and the Civic Engagement team to coordinate volunteer placements, outreach, and effective program implementation.

\*This position is grant funded, and continued employment is contingent upon the availability and renewal of funding and compliance with grant requirements. Positions may be modified or eliminated if funding is reduced, discontinued, or not renewed.\*

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

* A

The USC Dana and David Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences is seeking an Academic Program Specialist in the Academic Services Hub. The largest and oldest of the USC schools, USC Dornsife functions as the academic core of the university, offering courses and advancing knowledge across the humanities, social sciences and natural sciences.

Based on a divisional framework, Academic Services Hubs will provide staff support to approximately 35 departments across Dornsife. Each hub will serve one division and the number of departments per division varies. The mission of the Dornsife Academic Service Hubs is to provide optimal, localized support to academic departments by providing specialized services that foster the academic, instructional, and research-driven engagement of faculty, staff and students in the Dornsife community.

**North Orange County Community College District**

**Job Description:**  

**JOB****DESCRIPTION**  
  
Under the supervision of the FC APIDA Amplified Program Director and the Dean of Ethnic Studies & Student Equity, the APIDA Amplified **Program Specialist** will assist in developing and implementing academic support strategies to increase student recruitment and retention of students served by the college's APIDA Amplified Program, funded by the California AANHPI Student Achievement Program. The APIDA Amplified Program Specialist will assist with day-to-day operations, plan and facilitate programmatic efforts, and coordinate FC APIDA Resource Center activities. The AANHPI Student Achievement Program aims to provide culturally responsive services to enhance student educational experiences and promote higher education success for low- income, underserved, and first generation Asian American Native Hawaiian Pacific Islander (AANHPI) students and other underrepresented students.

Major goals of the AANHPI Student Achievement Program include:

* Improve key academic outcome indicators for APIDA and underrepresented students
* Provide APIDA-targeted mental health and wellness support through workshops, activities and opportunities for students and the community, and
* Establish APIDA culturally relevant career readiness support and programming for students. Additional grant goals include ensuring research informs service approaches, curricula, and overall campus operations to serve APIDA students more effectively.

To learn more about the APIDA Amplified Program, visit our website at apida.fullcoll.edu and our Instagram page @FCAPIDA.

**Responsibilities**

* Welcome and support students in the APIDA Resource Center by offering guidance, referrals, and a culturally affirming presence during daily operations
* Develop digital and print content, including flyers, newsletters, social posts, and outreach materials, to promote APIDA Resource Center programs, increase student visibility and engagement, and collaborate with Campus Communications for approval
* Conduct outreach efforts including giving presentations, tabling at events, and sharing announcements via Canvas and emails, to ensure that students, faculty, and staff are aware of program resources, opportunities, and upcoming events
* Manage the @FCAPIDA Instagram account and the APIDA Amplified email newsletter with upcoming events and announcements
* Plan, facilitate, and evaluate programmatic efforts that align with the goals outlined in the AANHPI Student Achievement Program
* Coordinate APIDA Resource Center activities, events, and initiatives by managing logistics, hosting events, communicating with team members, and ensuring smooth day-to-day execution
* Use Wordpress to update the apida.fullcoll.edu website with flyers and personnel changes
* Forge collaborations with campus departments, student organizations, and community partners to co-host culturally relevant events, workshops, and social media posts

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part-time)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 1500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: 1.) being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience, 2.) serve as back-up cashier at Fooda Cafés for team members who have time off, and 3.) driver responsibilities, delivering equipment and food to Fooda sites.
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Monday–Thursday: 6–10 a.m.  
  Friday: 7–11 a.m.

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

  
**Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages
* Paid time off
* A flexible part-time schedule (20 hours per week)
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Pre-tax commuter expense benefit
* Long-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda
* Networking opportunities for work or career with local restaurants
* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No phone calls or recruiters please.

We're looking for a highly skilled, growth-minded Digital Growth Strategist to join our Marketing team. This role requires deep, proven expertise in digital growth and performance marketing, with a sharp command of paid media, PPC, customer acquisition, and conversion strategy. A strong background working with performance marketing agencies is essential, including the ability to challenge recommendations, drive strategic direction, and hold partners accountable for performance and execution. jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

The Strategic Growth team is central to our growth efforts, focused on identifying and engaging real estate professionals who align with our mission. As an Associate Sales Development Representative, AKA **Strategic Growth Associate** (SGA), you will play a foundational role in our growth, helping to navigate a dynamic industry with significant opportunity. Unlike roles requiring a focus on market fit, you will serve as a market-facing growth professional responsible for territory strategy, business discovery, competitive intelligence, and pipeline development. This role combines consultative outreach with strategic market analysis to support long-term business growth.

We are seeking individuals with strong business acumen and professional discipline to join our organization. You will interact with real estate agents across various geographies, conducting discovery to understand their business challenges and contribute to territory strategy. This is a role with high visibility, where success is measured through consistent performance against established metrics. We provide a structured environment with dedicated coaching and development; in return, we look for individuals who demonstrate accountability, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to operational excellence.

Based in our Beverly Hills office, this onsite role offers the opportunity to work alongside local teams and gain hands-on experience supporting the market.

**ROLE SPECIFICS**

* **Own Top-of-Funnel Pipeline:** Drive net-new pipeline through a strategic mix of inbound support and targeted outbound campaigns.
* **Consultative Discovery:** Conduct structured qualification calls to understand agent production, growth pain points, and business timelines.
* **Territory Strategy:** Lead day-to-day prospecting strategy for the territory; build multi-layered initiatives and execute micro-campaigns to drive market penetration.
* **Market Intelligence:** Serve as the pod’s insight engine by documenting competitive intel, objection trends, and market sentiment to keep the CRM a powerful sales tool.
* **Value-Driven Engagement:** Articulate our value proposition through personalized, high-value communication; move fast and obsess about the opportunity
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with SGMs and Enablement to pilot new talk tracks, participate in role-plays, and refine the sales process.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree with 1+ years of relevant experience with history of strong performance (SDR, Direct Sales)
* Strong interpersonal and rapport-building skills, glass-half-full mentality, with demonstrated leadership potential
* Self-starter attitude and ability to exercise judgment and solve difficult problems without direct supervision, comfortable with ambiguity
* Highly motivated and persistent; energized by high-volume outreach and motivated by pushback, maintaining enthusiasm, professionalism, and momentum in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication skills; ability to effectively lead client meetings and presentations
* Highly organized; ability to handle multiple deadlines simultaneously
* Track record of excellence across strategic, operational, and detail-demanding functional responsibilities

**COMPENSATION**

The base pay range for this position is $31.25-$36.06 per hour ($65,000-$75,000 annualized); however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location.

**Perks that You Need to Know About:**

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

**Do your best work, be your authentic self.**

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

jobs.description:
POVISON is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Logistics Operations Coordinator to support our U.S. logistics operations, with a primary focus on Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), final-mile, and white-glove delivery performance.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipments from warehouse dispatch through final delivery, coordinating with warehouses and carriers, proactively identifying transportation risks, resolving delivery exceptions, and supporting successful delivery execution.

The Logistics Operations Coordinator will work closely with U.S. Operations, warehouses, carriers, finalmile delivery teams, internal support teams, and POVISON's China-based team to ensure issues are identified early and driven through resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor the end-to-end post-shipment process for DTC orders, from warehouse dispatch through successful final delivery.
* Track shipment and delivery status throughout the transportation process and maintain visibility of open or at-risk orders.
* Monitor warehouse and carrier exceptions in real time, including pickup delays, transit delays, prolonged tracking inactivity, damaged shipments, lost shipments, and delivery failures.
* Proactively identify orders at risk of becoming service exceptions based on shipment milestones, tracking activity, historical trends, and carrier performance.
* Take preventive action by communicating with warehouses, carriers, final-mile providers, and internal teams before issues escalate.
* Coordinate POVISON's final-mile and white-glove home delivery operations, including delivery scheduling, access concerns, address issues, product questions, reschedules, returns, and delivery exceptions.
* Manage transportation and delivery exceptions including damaged or missing products, customer refusals, unable-to-fit situations, incomplete deliveries, unsuccessful delivery attempts, and assembly or installation concerns.
* Ensure appropriate photos, notes, tracking information, and supporting documentation are collected when necessary.
* Maintain ownership of open exceptions and drive issues toward resolution while providing timely updates to the appropriate teams.
* Respond to logistics-related requests including address changes, expedited delivery requests, shipment intercepts, and other delivery needs.
* Communicate and coordinate regularly with POVISON's China-based team in Mandarin and English regarding shipment status, inventory questions, product concerns, damages, delivery exceptions, and issue resolution.
* Utilize shipment tracking data and carrier performance information to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Maintain accurate logistics records and provide Operations leadership with visibility into shipment performance, delivery issues, and unresolved exceptions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Mandarin and English.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and commonly used formulas/ functions.
* Ability to independently draft professional business communications regarding shipment exceptions, logistics inquiries, carrier issues, and delivery updates.
* Strong analytical, logical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify potential risks from shipment tracking data and operational trends.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving with a strong sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments and exception cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong cross-functional coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with warehouses, carriers, delivery teams, internal departments, and international teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Logistics Management, Supply Chain, Statistics, Accounting, E-Commerce, Business, or a related field.
* Previous experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, e-commerce, or final-mile delivery.
* Experience in cross-border e-commerce or Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) operations.
* Experience with furniture, home delivery, or white-glove final-mile delivery.
* Experience working directly with warehouses, carriers, and international teams.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant / Team Administrator (Events and Visits)
jobs.description:
**Position Title - Ingoa Tūranga**

Executive Assistant / Team Administrator (Events and Visits)

**Post – Te Aka Aorere**

New Zealand Consulate-General, Los Angeles

**Reports to - Menetia**

Administration Manager

**About the Consulate-General**

The New Zealand Consulate-General in Los Angeles (the Post), acts in the world to build a safer, more prosperous and more sustainable future for New Zealanders. We do this by building connections with and influencing other countries to advance New Zealand’s interests, project New Zealand values and secure the outcomes that matter to New Zealand. We pursue the Government’s international priorities and provide advice to the Government on the implications for New Zealand of what is happening in the world.

Our work contributes to the wellbeing of New Zealanders in the following ways:

* **Kaitiakitanga**: Generations of New Zealanders benefit from sustainable solutions to global and regional challenges;
* **Prosperity**: New Zealanders have better job opportunities and incomes from trade, investment and other international connections;
* **Security**: New Zealanders are able to live, do business, travel and communicate more safely at home and offshore;
* **Influence:** New Zealanders have confidence their country can influence others on issues that matter for them now and in the future.

**Diversity and Inclusion - Kanorau, Kauawhi**

We aspire to be a workplace that values and utilises diverse and inclusive thinking, people and behaviours. This means that our staff reflect the diversity of New Zealand and the countries we work in, and that the contributions of staff with diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected.

Our values are:

* **Impact:** We achieve for New Zealand, every day, everywhere
* **Kotahitanga:** We draw strength from our diversity
* **Courage:** We do the right thing
* **Manaakitanga:** We honour and respect others

The Post recognises the importance of staff having some flexibility around work hours and working arrangements to maintain a work/life balance. The Consulate has set public open hours and require a certain number of staff to be working in the office each day. HOP, DHOP, and Policy Adviser often need to be able to leave the office to attend external meetings.

There are also situations where the Post’s business deliverables require staff to be available during certain hours of the day, or evening, or for longer periods to meet a temporary surge in work requirements.

**About the Position - Mō te Tūranga**

The Executive Assistant / Team Administrator (Events and Visits) is responsible for providing executive assistant support to the Consul-General / Head of Post (HOP) and team administration functions to the Post to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the office. The position has a particular emphasis on event and visit coordination to ensure smooth running of the cultural, public and commercial diplomacy projects and events.

The role will also provide general administrative support for the team, and includes back-up support responsibilities for property asset management, security, vehicle management, and back-up consular support.

Other responsibilities will include contributing to social media and public diplomacy initiatives. Los Angeles is a self-driving Post, so an essential requirement of this position is that the Executive Assistant / Team Administrator (Events and Visits)obtains and holds a valid Californian driver licence and is willing and able to drive Post vehicles in support of the Consulate’s official duties.

**Key Accountabilities - Kawenga Matua**

The following key accountabilities of this role assist in delivering the Ministry’s purpose:

**Executive Administration**

* Provide Executive support and administrative services to the HOP e.g., scheduling appointments and diary management, welcoming visitors and provision of hospitality to visitors, drafting of correspondence for the HOP’s signature etc.
* Coordinate and book official travel and transportation for the HOP and Deputy Head of Post (DHOP), deconflicting bookings with other staff as required.
* Travel programme coordination for the HOP and DHOP including travel and hotel bookings, meeting requests and arrangements and other related items such as gifts, dress code information for events.
* Manage and reconcile expenses, corporate credit card transactions and reimbursement claims for the Head of Post, ensuring compliance with financial policies and maintaining accurate supporting records.
* Arrange and organise functions, meetings, presentations, conferences and workshops including venues, catering and associated agendas and documents as appropriate.
* Coordinate logistical aspects of both inward and outward official visits and events. Including guest lists, invitations, programmes, accommodation and transport arrangements, briefings documentation, contact database and appointments.
* Print briefing materials, meeting papers, speaking notes and correspondence for the HOP.

**Events Coordination**

* Coordinate the successful execution of events at the Chancery, the Official Residence, and at other locations as required.
* Liaise with the event Manager (HOP, Post Staff or external stakeholder) on the purpose and outcomes sought from the event. Support with ideas on how to execute the event.
* Liaise with and brief external providers about visits and events, ensuring all aspects of the process are managed in accordance with instructions, policies and processes and in a timely manner.
* Support event preparation and execution by purchasing and delivering goods, assisting with event set-up and take down, and escorting event contractors.
* Working with the event organiser, where appropriate, ensure provision for protective security for New Zealand and local VIPs at post events.

**Official Facilitations**

* Manage flight clearance requests – record requests received and liaise with stakeholders

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Bogart Construction is a licensed commercial general contractor with more than 30 years of experience delivering tenant improvements and ground-up projects nationwide. Our portfolio includes grocery, retail, restaurant, automotive, entertainment, and more. We are known for strong client partnerships, innovative solutions, and an unwavering commitment to safety and quality.

At Bogart Construction, our greatest asset is our people. We place a high value on investing not only in the growth of our company but also in the development and success of our team.

**Job Description**

The **Assistant Project Manager** (APM) supports the Project Manager in the planning, execution, and successful completion of commercial construction projects. This position will primarily support retail renovation, expansion, and ground-up projects, while developing the skills necessary to independently manage projects. The APM is responsible for project documentation, subcontractor administration, procurement tracking, compliance management, change order support, scheduling assistance, and coordination with field operations. The APM may be assigned to manage smaller projects up to approximately $3,000,000 in contract value under the direction of the Project Manager and Project Executive.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist the Project Manager with all phases of project execution from preconstruction through closeout.
* Manage assigned projects up to approximately $3,000,000 in contract value as directed.
* Obtain, submit, track, and distribute project submittals and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Maintain project documentation including procurement logs, submittal logs, RFI logs, change order logs, drawing logs, meeting minutes, schedules, and closeout documents.
* Review drawing revisions, CCDs, SKs, and owner directives and identify potential cost and schedule impacts.
* Assist with subcontractor buyout, bid solicitation, contract administration, and procurement activities.
* Create the SWPPP book and apply for state and local SWPPP permits/NOIs for the project.
* Draft and issue letters of intent, purchase orders, and subcontracts as directed.
* Track subcontractor compliance requirements including insurance, contracts, labor compliance, and project-specific documentation.
* Assist with project cost tracking, change order preparation, owner pay applications, and subcontractor pay application review.
* Assist with schedule updates, procurement tracking, and identification of schedule risks.
* Coordinate owner-furnished and contractor-furnished material deliveries with field staff.
* Attend project meetings, subcontractor meetings, preconstruction meetings, and site visits as required.
* Create and distribute meeting minutes, weekly reports, and client-required project reporting.
* Support client compliance requirements including worker verification, labor documentation, audit preparation, project reporting, etc.
* Partner with Superintendents to identify and resolve project issues related to schedule, quality, procurement, and subcontractor performance.
* Assist with project closeout including punch lists, warranties, O&M manuals, as-builts, and turnover documentation.
* Attend pre-con meetings as required by PM or PX.

  

**General Requirements**

* Self-motivated and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities.
* Professional demeanor and ability to maintain positive working relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Adaptable and flexible to changing project requirements.
* Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.
* Capability to maintain a standing or seated posture for prolonged periods.
* Dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other business-related machines.
* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new computer programs and software.
* Commitment to professional growth and continuing education.

  

**Specific Requirements**

* Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in commercial construction, retail construction, or ground-up construction.
* Ability to work from the main office or job sites and attend weekly staff meetings.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Procore, Bluebeam, and construction management software.
* Working knowledge of project scheduling software, including Microsoft Project, preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, contracts, lease exhibits, and construction documents.
* Negotiation, dispute resolution, and financial/job cost accounting skills required.
* Understanding of project cost controls, change management, scheduling, and procurement processes.
* Knowledge of construction methods, materials, and industry regulations.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Bachelor's Degree (or in progress) in Construction Management, Architecture, Construction Science, or a related field (or equivalent industry certification).
* Additional relevant work experience may be accepted as a substitute for a Bachelor's Degree.
* Reports directly to the Project Manager.

  

**Benefits:**

* 401(k) + matching
* Medical / Dental / Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program

jobs.title: Landscape Project Coordinator: PT with Room for Advancement
jobs.description:
Part-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes | East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10-12 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that +**  
**$28-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience, and our company's infrastructure.

This is a part-time position to start, with approximately **10-12 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners and our office manager to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day-to-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day-to-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the team at large.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners. You will be involved with design and sales meetings as needed, but this is not the primary function of your role.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients for their projects. This will be during active construction, as well as pre-construction.
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts as needed

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have strong practical knowledge of landscape construction, hardscape, irrigation, planting, or related construction
* Be able to read and understand plans and translate them into real-world construction
* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients
* Be kind, patient, friendly, and professional even and especially when dealing with difficult situations
* Communicate confidently and respectfully with field crews while maintaining clear expectations and a collaborative working relationship
* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail
* Notice when something isn't right and be willing to speak up
* Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Be highly organized and capable of keeping track of many moving pieces
* Be comfortable taking ownership and following things through to completion
* Understand that the details of the client experience matter just as much as the finished landscape

We are a **small, high-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth & Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owners and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day-to-day coordination as the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside our on & offsite leadership, and owners as applicable.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

We are a growing company with a collaborative team culture and a genuine commitment to the people who work with us. We care about doing excellent work, treating people well, and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding our employee benefits and opportunities, including:

* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performance-based bonuses
* Employee discounts
* PTO
* Opportunities for advancement and increasing responsibility
* A supportive, collaborative team environment
* A company culture that values communication, respect, craftsmanship, and personal growth
* Benefits currently being developed, including a 401(k) with employer matching and heal

jobs.title: K-8 After-School Program Coordinator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with youth and being part of a diverse, supportive, and talented community? Are you passionate about youth program development and are a natural leader? If so, please consider joining our team at Tessellations. We are currently accepting applications for a part-time K-8 After-School Program Coordinator starting immediately. Full-time summer Camp employment opportunities are available following the school year. Competitive salary available.

Tessellations is a modern, innovative Preschool-8th non-profit school for gifted learners based in Cupertino, CA. Our mission is to provide challenging experiential education that recognizes and nurtures the individual strengths of gifted learners, empowering them to confidently express who they are and pursue a meaningful life.

At Tessellations, community is a core value. A strong community was instrumental in launching our school during the pandemic and has facilitated our strong growth and success since then. Our team consists of passionate, qualified, and dedicated staff from diverse backgrounds and includes a nationally renowned gifted expert. We believe that it is time to open a new chapter in 21st-century gifted education by forging a model that fosters a cultural ecosystem within the school that promotes innovative thinking and intellectual risk-taking. Moving on from an antiquated model born during the Industrial Revolution, we favor transferable skills over compliance and rote memorization, and collaboration over competition. We believe that assessments should function as guidance for the depth and complexity of learning rather than for judgment or sorting.

**About Our After-School Program**

Our after-school program, Base Camp, provides program options for our wonderful TK - 8th grade students following the school day. We currently operate three programs, TK-Base Camp, Odyssey, and Clubs, until 6:00 pm Monday - Thursday and until 5:00 pm on Fridays. Our Odyssey and Club programs are open to K-8. Students participating in Odyssey are able to reset from a full day of instruction by engaging in self-directed indoor/outdoor play with peers, relaxing in the Oasis Room, completing homework, and or engaging in a teacher-led activity. Our enrichment Clubs are offered seasonally with offerings in the subject categories of social studies, sports and movement, world languages, arts and crafts, and STEM. Clubs typically meet once a week for 60 minutes to 120 minutes and are led by Base Camp Teachers, Tessellations Faculty, and local enrichment program vendors.

By working at Tessellations, you will work with students who love to learn, engaged parents/guardians who are grateful for your work, and supportive colleagues who will help bring out your personal best.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work Schedule: Mon-Thu: 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM; Fri 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
* Design and implement age-appropriate educational, creative, and physical enrichment activities tailored to K-8 students for our day camps.
* Create and foster a safe and nurturing learning environment where all students feel seen, heard, and included.
* Co-develop and facilitate engaging, student-centered enrichment activities spanning arts, STEM, and recreation that nurture elementary curiosity while encouraging middle school autonomy.
* Maintain an active and visible leadership presence within the department during operational hours, empowering staff and decisively addressing real-time operational needs in the Director's absence.
* Serve as the heart of our program’s connection with families, making sure parents/guardians feel well-informed, deeply supported, and actively invited into their child’s after-school journey.
* Support student self-regulation by implementing restorative methods, early de-escalation strategies, and growth-mindset praise that recognizes hard work and dedication.
* Facilitate restorative conflict resolution between peers, helping students identify feelings and communicate needs.
* Work with the other Base Camp staff to supervise the students during indoor and outdoor play, snack time, and transition periods.
* Track daily student attendance and follow secure student check-in/check-out procedures with authorized parents/guardians/caregivers.
* Maintain a safe and organized environment, supervising students closely at all times.
* Serve as a versatile team member by filling in for absent staff on short notice, seamlessly adapting to different roles and shifts to maintain continuous, high-quality operations.
* Support the Program Director with the coordination and facilitation of our academic competitions.
* Attend staff meetings and actively engage with professional development opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of elementary and middle school experience, preferably in an after-school or summer camp program setting.
* Minimum of 1 year working with transitional kindergarten, preschool, or kindergarten-aged children (experience in after-school or summer camp settings).
* Ability to actively observe, read, and accurately interpret youth’s verbal and non-verbal cues to meet their emotional and developmental needs in real-time.
* A genuine commitment to inclusive practices that welcome and celebrate families from all backgrounds.
* Strong verbal communication skills
* Passing a criminal background check upon job offer.
* Current CPR and First Aid certifications (or willingness to obtain upon hire).
* Curriculum development experience
* High school diploma or GED

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Social-emotional teaching experience
* Experience teaching gifted learners
* Proficiency with technology (G Suite in particular)
* Familiarity with and commitment to DEIJ issues
* Experience teaching twice-exceptional learners
* Connection to nature
* Enthusiastic lifelong learner
* Openness and flexibility in designing improved learning experiences

**Compensation**

Salary: $25.00 to $36.00 per hour, depending on experience

*Bene

jobs.title: Manager, Field Marketing & Events
jobs.description:
Our customers and partners are used to the way legacy networking has operated for decades. We strongly believe that events are a highly effective way for our audience to understand what Meter does and why we’re different from these legacy solutions. Events are often where customers, partners, network engineers, and future teammates first experience Meter. This role makes sure every one of those moments count and deliver results back to the business.

Meter is looking for a leader who has built events at a company that was growing faster than its playbook. You’ve run a flagship conference and taken a program on the road to multiple cities. You see events as a strategic growth lever, energized by the challenge of transforming ambitious ideas into measurable pipeline growth and stronger brand visibility. You know the best events start weeks before the attendees arrive and keep working long after they leave. You’ve led teams that have a reputation of being “the best of the best”, and you want to do it again.

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Events are already proven as a successful channel for Meter, backed by investments that make up about 30% of our marketing budget. This year, the team took Meter on the road to 13 cities with Meter Circuit, our roadshow event series. We showed up at NRF, RSA, Channel Partners, Educause, and others, plus dozens of industry and regional shows and partner events. Sales and partners are running even more events on their own in the field. And now we’re shifting our focus to MeterUp, our flagship conference taking place in April 2027.

You’ll lead the team that makes it all happen, ensuring every event has a clear goal, feels uniquely Meter, and shows its return. Across strategic events, field marketing, partner events, internal brand, and EMEA, the team is already strong. We need a leader who keeps raising the bar.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

In your first month, you know each person on the team, their scope, and where they want to grow. You’ve met GTM leaders in every region and learned how events are currently being leveraged, where they are working, and where we have room to improve.

Within three months, you’ve delivered an updated events strategy and FY28 calendar, developed in alignment with marketing and GTM leaders. You’ve published an event standard for Meter covering promotion, pre-event comms, onsite experience, and follow-up. Sales has a clear intake process, self-serve playbook, and view into our calendar of events. You’ve set clear pipeline targets for the team and every event reports pipeline at 30, 60, and 90 days, including partner-led events.

Over time, you’ll shape how Meter shows up in person across every region and audience as the company scales.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You’ve led a growing events or field marketing team at a high-growth company
* You’ve run both field marketing and strategic events. You use field events as a data-driven lever for growth, but you know brand events drive pipeline too.
* You’ve worked closely with partners, or in a channel-led company.
* You measure everything. You love seeing your team’s direct impact and sharing that story with the company.
* You build a partnership with sales, not a service desk. Sales feels supported, and your team’s time goes to the programs that matter most.
* You care how people experience a brand. One great event can change how someone sees Meter: as a customer, partner, future teammate, or industry voice.
* You believe every event can be high value, from a small regional partner sponsorship to MeterUp.
* You aren’t satisfied with what’s been done before. You push your team to try new things.
* You move with intentional urgency. You know when to slow down and when to challenge the pace.
* You hold a high bar and inspire others around you to do their best work.
* You lead with Meter’s core values: kindness, ambition, optimism, and paranoia.

**Why Meter?**
--------------

Meter is a vertically integrated networking company. Hardware, software, services, ISP, and autonomous networks—all built on a single data pipeline from the local network to the data center.

The internet runs the world. Every purchase you make, video call you join, it's all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.

We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.

Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.

**Compensation**
----------------

* The estimated base salary for this role is between $150,000 - $200,000.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Meter's equity plan.

By applying to this job you acknowledge that you've read and understood Meter's Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Social Media Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
What we're looking for

**Social Media Account Coordinator**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Sparq Marketing is hiring a Social Media Account Coordinator to run day-to-day marketing for a retail shopping center client in Palo Alto. You will plan and publish social content, promote the center's stores and restaurants, support a full calendar of community events, and report on results each month.

This is a hands-on coordinator role with real variety. One day you are building next month's content calendar with the creative team, and the next you are on site for a photoshoot or emailing store managers about an upcoming sidewalk sale. It suits someone who is organized, comfortable talking with local business owners, and happy to own the details.

Sparq Marketing is a social media and digital marketing agency serving local, brick-and-mortar, and commercial clients.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Social media and content**

* Build the monthly content calendar with the creative team, covering feed posts, stories, and reels
* Publish stories and manage daily community engagement: comments, DMs, tags, and reposts of tenant content
* Source, brief, and manage local influencer partnerships from outreach through reporting
* Run giveaways from planning to winner follow-up
* Plan quarterly photoshoots, including shot lists, tenant scheduling, and community models

**Tenant promotions and email**

* Collect monthly promotions from tenants and publish them to the website, email newsletter, and social channels
* Build and send the monthly email newsletter, plus dedicated emails for events and new store openings
* Keep the website current: events and promotions, the store directory, and job listings

**Events and tenant relations**

* Support about 15 community events a year, such as sidewalk sales, scavenger hunts, and holiday events
* Recruit tenant participation, send reminders and check-ins, and gather feedback afterward
* Promote events across social, local listing sites, and partners like the chamber of commerce and area hotels
* Onboard new tenants to the center's marketing programs and coordinate grand opening coverage
* Manage the on-site poster program and the annual marketing opportunities packet

**Design and paid ads**

* Create event posters, maps, signage, and digital ad assets, with manager approval
* Set up Meta ads and boosted posts each month and track ad spend

**Reporting and administration**

* Prepare monthly reports on social, email, website, and marketing activity
* Prepare agendas, present updates, and take notes for bi-weekly operations meetings and quarterly marketing meetings
* Collect vendor invoices, W-9s, and certificates of insurance, and route them for approval

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 1-2 years of experience in social media, marketing coordination, or account management
* Hands-on experience managing Instagram and Facebook for a business or brand
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, including boosted posts and traffic campaigns
* Experience with an email platform such as Mailchimp and comfort making basic website updates
* Graphic design skills in Canva or similar tools
* Clear, friendly writing for captions, emails, and campaign briefs
* Strong organization and follow-through across many deadlines and contacts at once

jobs.description:
***\*\*The location of this position is Benioff Children's Hospital in Oakland, CA\*\****

The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI) in the Department of Pediatrics. This position will operate in one or more divisions within the Department of Pediatrics and will likely support multiple investigators. Assignments may change based on funding availability. May coordinate the operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.

The position’s duties include enrolling patients in clinical studies, data entry and management, biospecimen collection and processing, attending and documenting proceedings at relevant meetings, preparing grant proposals and reports, completing regulatory documents, Institutional Review Board applications, revisions and reports, and other duties as assigned.

CRC duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules and assist the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of Institutional Review Board applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

**Department Overview:**

The Department of Pediatrics is one of the largest and most complex departments in the School of Medicine (SOM). The Department is comprised of 18 divisions employing over 400 core faculty, 83 fellows, 84 residents, 31 Post Docs and non-faculty academics, and 300 staffs. The Department has annual clinical income from inpatient and outpatient activities totaling over $100 million and annual extramural funding (contracts and grants) exceeding $58 million. The Department ranks 21st in the nation among pediatric departments for funding from the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

The Department’s clinical enterprise is based at the 183-bed UCSF Benioff Children’s Hospital San Francisco, the 191-bed UCSF Benioff Children’s Hospital Oakland, Mount Zion, Zuckerberg San Francisco General, and at a number of outreach clinics throughout Northern California, providing the Department with an unsurpassed opportunity to meet the needs of infants, children, and young adults throughout the Bay Area. In 2020, UCSF Benioff Children’s Hospitals ranked in all 10 children’s specialties in U.S. News and World Report.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze off

Working as a Customer Success Manager at Uber means moving beyond the polished surface of account management to solve the complex, high-stakes operational realities our largest enterprise partners face every day. You will be the bridge between our digital platform and the physical storefronts of our most important enterprise partners, ensuring that Uber remains their preferred delivery engine through relentless analytical rigor and hands-on problem solving.

If you prefer a predictable, transactional routine over the rewarding but demanding work of scaling global partnerships, this may not be the right fit for you.

* Build and grow long-term partnerships by deeply understanding what matters most to our enterprise customers, moving beyond simple product support to deliver tangible business value.

* Solve messy, high-impact problems using data-driven insights to identify patterns that impact experience at scale.
* Adapt your strategy based on shifting market dynamics and imperfect information to ensure partners see consistent ROI and platform reliability.
* Champion operational excellence by identifying and reducing "operational debt" while maintaining a high quality bar for your portfolio.
* Lead cross-functional collaborations with operations, product, and legal teams to shape and deliver solutions that scale.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience creating detailed execution plans for large-scale projects.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Demonstrated systems thinking with the ability to turn unstructured, ambiguous problems into focused execution plans.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Sprig**
===============

Sprig is the customer survey platform, rebuilt around AI agents.

For two decades, teams have relied on Qualtrics, Medallia, and SurveyMonkey to understand their customers. These platforms were built for a slower era, with manual setup, fragmented workflows, and insights that arrive too late to shape decisions. The gap between how fast products move and how fast research can keep up has never been wider.

We're building something different. With Sprig, AI agents design studies, adapt surveys in real time, and turn responses into clear, actionable insight. Teams move from question to evidence in hours instead of weeks, without sacrificing rigor. Product teams no longer guess. They know.

Our mission is to make deep customer understanding effortless and always on, so the best teams in the world can build products their customers love.

Companies like Microsoft, DoorDash, Notion, Figma, Coinbase, and TripAdvisor use Sprig to stay close to their users. Backed by $85M from Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, and First Round Capital, we're growing quickly across the world's leading product organizations.

The category is being rebuilt, with AI at the core. If you're excited by hard problems and the chance to define how modern teams understand their customers, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**
==================

As a **Customer Success Engineer** at Sprig, you will help customers successfully deploy, integrate, troubleshoot, and scale Sprig across their organizations. You’ll partner directly with product teams, researchers, and technical stakeholders to solve complex challenges and ensure customers maximize the value of our platform.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success and Solutions Engineering. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, own complex technical engagements, and act as a strong internal advocate for customer needs and product improvements.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys technical problem solving, customer interaction, and cross-functional collaboration, and who is comfortable independently navigating complex customer environments in a fast-moving environment.

**This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco office 4x per week.**

**Your Impact**

* Diagnose and troubleshoot integration issues, conduct technical demos, and align with business and product goals.
* Partner directly with customers to troubleshoot technical issues related to integrations, SDK implementations, APIs, survey deployments, and platform configuration
* Lead technical onboarding and implementation for a portfolio of mid-market customers, driving fast time-to-value so teams can roll out Sprig across their workflows
* Act as liaison with our product & engineering teams on escalations. Detailed discovery to allow product teams to efficiently address any issues.
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to identify common customer requests, test workarounds and new feature releases, and improve technical documentation to ensure customer success
* Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to support technical evaluations, renewals, expansions, and customer growth opportunities

**Your Strengths**

* 2-4+ years of experience as customer support engineer
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a genuine curiosity for understanding how systems work and the ability to independently navigate ambiguous technical problems
* Problem solver mindset - Hunger for understanding why something is happening and enjoy digging into the source code to troubleshoot issues
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Highly collaborative and energized by working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams
* Experience supporting mid-market customers at a SaaS company is preferred

**Benefits & Perks**
====================

* Competitive Salary
* Competitive Employee Equity
* 401K Program
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* FSA/HSA Benefit
* $175/month Commuter Benefit
* Additional Wellbeing Benefits
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Professional Development Stipend
* Lunch and dinner provided daily
* Company Sponsored Social Events

At Sprig, we pride ourselves on being a people-first company, where your contributions truly matter and are valued. We were recently awarded by *Fortune* as top 50 best places to work in the US, and top 50 Places to Work in the Bay Area by Built In. Come join our mission of building products users love and have a real impact on Sprig’s future.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
=============================================

We prioritize diversity within our team and value different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

**Employee Pay Disclosure**
===========================

The base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 - $135,000 + Equity + Benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all locations (San Francisco, CA; New York, NY). Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. A&G Transport Inc. is an established transportation and logistics company based in Oakland, California, specializing in port drayage, trucking, transloading, and warehousing services. We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Warehouse Logistics Coordinator to join our team and support our daily warehouse and transportation operations.

**Position Overview**

The Warehouse Logistics Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating freight movements, booking loads, tracking shipments, communicating with customers and truck drivers, and managing shipment-related documentation and billing. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can manage multiple shipments, stay organized, and ensure operations run efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and book inbound and outbound warehouse shipments, including pickups and deliveries.
* Schedule trucking appointments and coordinate freight movements with customers, carriers, and drivers.
* Track containers and shipments, providing timely updates to customers.
* Communicate with truck drivers, dispatchers, and warehouse personnel to ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain accurate shipment records, delivery schedules, and customer account information.
* Prepare and process shipping documents, including Bills of Lading (BOLs), delivery receipts, and other transportation paperwork.
* Calculate and record applicable charges, including transportation, storage, handling, detention, and other accessorial fees.
* Prepare customer invoices and ensure accurate and timely billing.
* Respond to customer inquiries, resolve shipment-related issues, and follow up on outstanding matters.
* Coordinate with internal operations and accounting teams to ensure accurate documentation and billing.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in the **transportation, trucking, logistics, or warehousing industry preferred**.
* Experience with freight coordination, load booking, or dispatch operations is an asset.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Familiarity with Transportation Management Systems (TMS) or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) is a plus.
* Experience with freight billing, invoicing, and accessorial charges preferred.

**Why Join A&G Transport?**

* Join an established and growing transportation and logistics company.
* Work closely with experienced transportation and warehouse professionals.
* Gain hands-on experience in port drayage, freight coordination, and warehouse operations.
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
